description:
Parse a document once for DeepSeek Flash; retain the returned id and reuse it in document_ids.

Requires an 8 to 128 character idempotency_key; reuse it after a timeout. PDF/Office/images
have a one-time page fee. user_data text/spreadsheets/ebooks are free. Handles last 30 days.
Original content is sent to DeepSeek. Data Guard does not mask this upload.
name: parse_chat_document
